its_muradnagar.facility: I.T.S. Centre for Dental Studies & Research, Murad Nagar
its_muradnagar.identity_basis: Official contact of the publisher names Delhi–Meerut Road, Murad Nagar, Ghaziabad 201206. That exact campus is the facility release I.T.S Dental College, Ghaziabad row. The similarly named Greater Noida operator uses a different website and address.

zydus_dahod.facility: Zydus Medical College and Hospital, Dahod
zydus_dahod.identity_basis: The signed hospital report and the facility release give the same hospital name, Dahod, Bhagini Samaj/Naheru Baug landmark and PIN 389151. Other Zydus hospitals in Gujarat use different locations.

himalayan.identity_basis: The release website is hihtindia.org. Its contact page gives the same 0135-2471200 and Swami Ram Nagar, Jolly Grant campus, and links Himalayan Hospital on srhu.edu.in. The NMC clinical material archive independently names that campus and hospital. Official PIN 248016 differs from the saved PIN 249201, which is recorded here without changing the release.

unmehta.facility: U. N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology & Research Centre, Ahmedabad
unmehta.identity_basis: Exact institute name, Ahmedabad, PIN 380016 and unchanged unmicrc.org domain agree; source tab is headed with the Ahmedabad institute, separate from links to satellite centres.

vishnu_dental.identity_basis: The release and publisher share the exact institution name and domain, Vishnupur at Bhimavaram, and PIN 534202. The contact page places Vishnu Dental College and Vishnu Dental Hospital at that address.

lok_nayak_delhi.identity_basis: This FDR release row names LNJP Hospital, New Delhi 110002 and links the Delhi government LNJP site. Its Ahilaya Bai College of Nursing Building address corresponds to the publisher’s Ahilya Bai College of Nursing at Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi 110002.
